Frozen Lane A format-10 corpus (2026-10-09).

Plain, ordered multiple paint, alpha mask and isolated alpha group: canonical JSON, native PDF and SVG.
Refusals cover older-era keys, future stamp, missing base slot and unsupported blend.
SHA256SUMS freezes all artifact bytes. Authoring example is explicit, never invoked by tests.
Existing v5-v9 and Bridge 1.0/1.1 fixtures are retained.
